newsitem.title: CROATIA: TENNIS-LOCAL HERO IVANISEVIC STRUGGLES IN FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-LOCAL HERO IVANISEVIC STRUGGLES IN FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Defending champion Goran Ivanisevic dropped a set on Wednesday before overcoming unseeded Swede Magnus Norman in an unexpectedly difficult first round tie at the Croatian indoor men's tournament.
Top seed Ivanisevic took two hours and 20 minutes to beat 20-year-old Norman 7-6 6-7 7-5 in front of about 4,000 supporters.
"I've played vary badly, it was only my serve that kept me alive," Ivanisevic said.
"I did not have any initiative, I've just tried to push the ball back across the net. It was a close shave...if I don't improve my game I won't fare well in this tournament."
In the second round Ivanisevic meets Thomas Johansson, another of the four Swedish players in the $400,000 tournament. Johansson beat Germany's Marc-Kevin Goellner 7-5 6-2 on Monday.
The only seeded player to drop out in the first round so far is number eight Hendrik Dreekmann of Germany, who lost to 7-6 6-2 to Romania's Alex Raduciou.
